name: Vanadium Magneli phase
equilibrium_context: Insulator-metal transition at about 250 K (Magneli series VnO2n-1)

driven_states.emergent_property: Ultrashort pulse excitation melts the correlated insulating state; the transient shows a second-order transition with separately identifiable electronic and lattice contributions.
driven_states.source: Bartenev et al., Adv. Electron. Mater. (2025), doi:10.1002/aelm.202400539
driven_states.caveat: The work separates electronic and lattice contributions explicitly, but does not classify the transition as purely electronic. Second order, therefore conceptually different from the first-order VO2 case. A very recent, unconfirmed single study - evidence level deliberately kept low. Photon energy assumed to be a typical Ti:sapphire excitation, not verified against the full text.

sources: Bartenev et al., Adv. Electron. Mater. (2025), doi:10.1002/aelm.202400539
gaps: Photon energy, fluence and lifetime not verified against the full text.
